message.content: I’m happy to help you find the best move! Could you please share the current board position? You can give me the FEN notation or describe the pieces’ locations (e.g., “White has a king on e1, queen on d1, rooks on a1/h1, knights on b1/g1, bishops on c1/f1, pawns on a2,b2,c2,d2,e2,f2,g2,h2; Black has …”). Once I know the exact setup, I’ll be able to suggest the optimal move for White.
